entries.07bc53e1d332a6ab: This domain operates the CtoC marketplace flea market app “Mercari” in Japan. Revenue in the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥129,526 million. Since October 2019 it has offered cross-border transactions that allow items listed in Japan to be purchased from overseas, and since October 2021 it has also operated the BtoC marketplace “Mercari Shops”.
entries.0d8ccc1cfaf6e0cd: Operation of the professional football club “Kashima Antlers”
entries.21549e14c45160a4: This domain provides payment and financial services in Japan. Revenue in the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥51,201 million. It includes the smartphone payment service “Merpay”, the credit card “Mercard”, which uses AI-based credit assessment drawing on usage history, and crypto-asset-related services provided by Merukoin Co., Ltd., among others.
entries.4a7d0c2b5e7b3e33: This is a reportable segment that operates mainly in Japan, centered on the flea market app “Mercari”. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥180,858 million. It consists of two domains: Marketplace and Fintech.
entries.60103fa57f56d9ad: Centered on the flea market app "Mercari," operates a peer-to-peer marketplace and fintech businesses such as payments and credit in Japan and the United States.
entries.ae3b0b772a4c77b4: This is a reportable segment that operates the CtoC marketplace “Mercari” in the United States. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥40,782 million. Its consolidated subsidiary Mercari, Inc. plans, develops and operates it.
entries.e67a08d26be330e5: Individuals who list items for sale
entries.fa81057979823b5d: This is a business segment not included in the reportable segments, which includes the sports business and others. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥7,653 million. It includes Kashima Antlers F.C. Co., Ltd., which operates the professional football club “Kashima Antlers” (ownership of voting rights: 71.2%, as of June 30, 2026).
